You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0242.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > /tmp/build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
rw=Chem.RWMol()
# carbon atoms indexed by conventional labels 1-27; O as 28
for i in range(27):
    a=Chem.Atom('C'); a.SetProp('name',f'C{i+1}')
    rw.AddAtom(a)
o=Chem.Atom('O'); o.SetProp('name','O3'); rw.AddAtom(o)
def bond(i,j,typ=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(i-1,j-1,typ)
# steroid rings
for i,j in [(1,2),(2,3),(3,4),(4,5),(5,10),(10,1),
            (5,6),(6,7),(7,8),(8,9),(9,10),
            (8,14),(14,13),(13,12),(12,11),(11,9),
            (13,17),(17,16),(16,15),(15,14),
            (13,18),(10,19),
            (17,20),(20,21),(20,22),(22,23),(23,24),(24,25),(25,26),(25,27)]:
    bond(i,j)
bond(5,6,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
bond(3,28)
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# desired configurations at the stereogenic carbons
wanted={3:'S',8:'R',9:'S',10:'R',13:'R',14:'S',17:'R',20:'R'}
for idx in wanted:
    m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx-1).SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for idx,w in wanted.items():
    at=m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx-1)
    got=at.GetProp('_CIPCode') if at.HasProp('_CIPCode') else None
    if got!=w:
        at.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('CIP',[(i,m.GetAtomWithIdx(i-1).GetProp('_CIPCode')) for i in wanted])
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=True))
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=242; params.useSmallRingTorsions=True
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed',status)
if status != 0: raise SystemExit('embed failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
print('mmff',props is not None)
ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props)
print('energy start',ff.CalcEnergy())
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
print('CIP post',[(i,m.GetAtomWithIdx(i-1).GetProp('_CIPCode') if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i-1).HasProp('_CIPCode') else None) for i in wanted])
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nCholesterol-like structure; MMFF optimized\n')
    for a in m.GetAtoms():
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
PY

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pathlib import Path
smi='OCC(N)[C@H](O)/C=C/CCCCCCCCCCCCC'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
assert m is not None
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed=239
params.useRandomCoords=False
params.numThreads=1
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
if res != 0: raise RuntimeError('embedding failed')
if AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m):
    ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m))
    ff.Minimize(maxIts=2000)
else:
    AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=2000)
conf=m.GetConformer()
# XYZ atom order matches molecule atoms, all explicitly hydrogenated.
lines=[str(m.GetNumAtoms()),'3D structure generated from 2D drawing']
for atom in m.GetAtoms():
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
    lines.append(f'{atom.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}')
Path('answer.xyz').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
# validation
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(),'carbons',sum(a.GetSymbol()=='C' for a in m.GetAtoms()))
print('stereo centers',[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode')) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp('_CIPCode')])
print('stereo double bonds',[(b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx(),str(b.GetStereo())) for b in m.GetBonds() if b.GetStereo()!=Chem.BondStereo.STEREONONE])
print('wrote answer.xyz')

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for i in range(27):
    rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('C'))
rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('O')) # idx 27, bonded to C3
edges=[(1,2),(2,3),(3,4),(4,5),(5,10),(10,1),
       (6,7),(7,8),(8,9),(9,10),
       (8,14),(14,13),(13,12),(12,11),(11,9),
       (13,17),(17,16),(16,15),(15,14),
       (13,18),(10,19),(17,20),(20,21),(20,22),(22,23),(23,24),(24,25),(25,26),(25,27)]
for i,j in edges: rw.AddBond(i-1,j-1,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(4,5,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE) # C5=C6
rw.AddBond(2,27,Chem.BondType.SINGLE) # C3-O
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
wanted={3:'S',8:'R',9:'S',10:'R',13:'R',14:'S',17:'R',20:'R'}
for n in wanted: m.GetAtomWithIdx(n-1).SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for n,target in wanted.items():
    a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(n-1)
    if not a.HasProp('_CIPCode'):
        raise ValueError(f'C{n} is not stereogenic')
    if a.GetProp('_CIPCode') != target:
        a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('CIP labels:',[(n,m.GetAtomWithIdx(n-1).GetProp('_CIPCode')) for n in wanted])
print('SMILES:',Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=True))
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=242; params.useSmallRingTorsions=True; params.numThreads=1
if AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)!=0: raise RuntimeError('embedding failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props is None: raise RuntimeError('MMFF parameters unavailable')
ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props); print('initial MMFF energy',ff.CalcEnergy())
ff.Minimize(maxIts=2000)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('Atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(),'elements', {e:sum(a.GetSymbol()==e for a in m.GetAtoms()) for e in ('C','O','H')})
print('Final CIP:',[(n,m.GetAtomWithIdx(n-1).GetProp('_CIPCode')) for n in wanted])
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nCholesterol structure; all hydrogens explicit\n')
    for a in m.GetAtoms():
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
